title: cyber security awarness workshop
summary: Rotary Club of Mumbai Downtown Sea Land, in association with Pratham Foundation, organised a Cyber Security Awareness Workshop for students at SNDT Women's University, Churchgate, Mumbai.
description:
Rotary Club of Mumbai Downtown Sea Land, in association with Pratham Foundation, organised a Cyber Security Awareness Workshop for students at SNDT Women's University, Churchgate, Mumbai.

The main objective of this workshop was to create awareness among students about the growing challenges of cybercrime and the importance of digital safety in today's technology-driven world.

The workshop focused on important topics such as online fraud prevention, social media safety, protection of personal information, password security, cyber threats, and responsible internet usage.

Dr. Sanjay Sir, Project Head, played an important role in planning, coordinating, and organising this meaningful educational initiative.

Under Rotary's theme "Creative Lasting Impact," this project aimed to empower young women with essential knowledge and practical awareness to navigate the digital world safely, confidently, and responsibly.
